system.description:
This martial training skill allows a character to fight effectively with a weapon in his off hand. This secondary the weapon must be smaller or of equal weight to his other weapon. Both weapons must be one-handed and be at most long weapon length.

When fighting with two weapons, there is no penalty for striking with a weapon in the off hand. If a player wants to Strike with both weapons simultaneously, divide his dice between his two weapons. The character may perform Block & Strike actions as if he had Shield Training. Skill dice are divided between attack and defense as the combatant sees fit.

*Training Root is for Aptitude only.

Skill Type: Martial Training. Tools: No.

Root: Agility*

Source: Burning Wheel Gold Revised, p. 306
